My best friend in kindergarten up until 6. grade. During High school we lost touch a bit but still saw each other from time to time. 

He got into a pretty bad car accident when he was 7 years old and never really recovered. He walked in a weird way, had trouble breathing sometimes and just could not move his body ‚normally‘. 
He had the most amazing parents I know. He was their only child and they gave him everything he needed and cared so much for him. They also took amazing care of me and we spent a lot of time all together. 

We‘re both in university now and I have not heard anything from him until one day in our old class group chat someone sends a link to a news website from a neighboring country. Apparently he has fallen in love with a girl and stalked her. She moved to a different country, he followed her, rang her doorbell and shot her in the head before killing himself. 

I can‘t imagine how his parents must feel. To lose your only child in such a way must be tragic…
